title: LLM-Based Persuasion Enables Guardrail Override in Frontier LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Multi-turn LLM-to-LLM persuasion probing to measure the subject model's refusal robustness against writing persuasive essays that argue for racial cognitive hierarchies (innate cognitive differences between racial groups).
Multi-turn LLM-to-LLM persuasion probing to evaluate whether the subject model can be pressured into overriding safety guardrails to generate persuasive essays promoting Holocaust denial.

Multi-turn LLM-to-LLM persuasion probing to elicit against-consensus persuasive essays on contested scientific and medical topics, including anthropogenic climate change denial, vaccine safety denial, creationism, and flat-earth cosmology.
